translation: From the Kanesh colony to the datum-payers, our messenger, every colony, and the trading stations: A letter of the City has arrived.
Send a copy of our letter to every single colony and to the trading stations. Whether he sold meteoric iron for merchants, write the name of the man.
In accordance with the tablet of the City, whoever buys meteoric iron from this very day will be deducted from the profit or will not be deducted from the profit, the Kanesh colony will take it.

As soon as you have heard our letter, whether he has sold it to a palace there, or has holding the orders of the palace, or has not yet sold it. However much meteoric iron he carries, write the name of the meteoric iron, his name and his father's name on a tablet and send it to me on our messenger.
